Messages.Body:
Can Vamp A, in combat with Vamp B, Theft of B's Vitae for 2 then,
at the end of the round, Taste of B's Vitae for those 2?
From reading the card, it seems like this is allowed so long as A is
not going to Torpor.
Confirmation?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
"Sorrow" <cbo...@apdi.net> wrote:
> Can Vamp A, in combat with Vamp B, Theft of B's Vitae for 2 then,
> at the end of the round, Taste of B's Vitae for those 2?
> From reading the card, it seems like this is allowed so long as A is
> not going to Torpor.
> Confirmation?

Sorry. While card text supports your theory, Taste has been errata'ed to
only count blood lost to damage:

Taste of Vitae - combat

* Only counts blood that the opposing vampire burned as a result of
damage. It will not, for example, give blood for blood spent playing
combat cards or stolen blood. [RTR 960124]
